name: ONEOK
description: ONEOK runs a network of gas gathering and processing plants, natural gas liquids (NGL) pipelines and fractionators, natural gas pipelines and storage, and refined products and crude pipelines across the Mid-Continent, Rocky Mountain, Permian and Gulf Coast regions. It is paid mainly fees for moving and processing volumes, with a layer of commodity sales (NGLs, residue gas, refined products) that inflate reported revenue and are largely offset in cost of sales. Revenue jumped from $21.7B to $33.6B in 2025 largely because of acquisitions (EnLink, Medallion, Delaware Basin JV buy-in), and adjusted EBITDA rose to $8,020M from $6,784M.

businessLines.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing
businessLines.how: Producers pay fees to gather, compress, treat and process their gas, plus the company keeps some NGLs and residue gas under percent-of-proceeds style contracts and sells them at market prices.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP; the 10-K segment profit measure)

businessLines.name: Natural Gas Liquids
businessLines.how: Fees to move NGLs on its pipelines, fractionate them and store/export them (exchange services), plus buying and selling NGLs for optimization and marketing margin.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP; the 10-K segment profit measure)

businessLines.name: Natural Gas Pipelines
businessLines.how: Capacity reservation and transportation fees on intrastate gas pipelines plus storage fees; residue gas sales from EnLink added in 2025.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP; the 10-K segment profit measure)

businessLines.name: Refined Products and Crude
businessLines.how: Fees for pipeline transportation, storage and terminaling of refined products and crude (Medallion and EnLink crude added), plus product sales with offsetting cost of sales.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP; the 10-K segment profit measure)

brands.name: EnLink Midstream
brands.note: All publicly held EnLink units acquired in a tax-free transaction completed 2025-01-31; adds gathering, processing and crude assets to three segments.

brands.name: Medallion (crude, Permian)
brands.note: Acquired in 2024 (full-year earnings in 2025); in Refined Products and Crude.
